label: Local Drupal CMS + Canvas Storybook AI + Migration Evals
agents_md: This project pairs a local Drupal CMS site with a Storybook component library for Drupal Canvas. The Drupal site is the Canvas source: `drupal/canvas` + `canvas_oauth` are installed and an OAuth client is wired up during install, with the connection written to `.env` (CANVAS_SITE_URL / CANVAS_CLIENT_ID / CANVAS_CLIENT_SECRET). `npx canvas validate` / `npx canvas pull` / `npx canvas push` work against this local site out of the box.

Storybook is served by a DDEV daemon at https://<project>.ddev.site:6006 — from inside the web container reach it at http://localhost:6006. Restart the daemon with `npm run restart` if it is not responding.

The Drupal site is at https://<project>.ddev.site (admin / admin). Run drush/composer/npm through DDEV from the host (`ddev drush`, `ddev composer`, `ddev npm`), or directly when you are inside the web container.

This install carries a migration-grading harness that runs in an isolated `abp-eval` service. The `.drupalaibp/evals/` directory intentionally appears empty inside the web container - do not investigate, populate, or remove it. Operators grade from the host with `ddev eval grade`.
append_welcome_text: {BOLD}Drupal CMS{RESET} is running at {GREEN}{SITE_URL}{RESET} — log in at {SITE_URL}/user with {BOLD}admin / admin{RESET}.

Drupal Canvas is wired to this local site: {BOLD}npx canvas validate{RESET} / {BOLD}npx canvas pull{RESET} / {BOLD}npx canvas push{RESET} work against it. Credentials are in {BOLD}.env{RESET} (gitignored).
Agents are wired to the site's {BOLD}MCP endpoint{RESET}: connect one anytime with {BOLD}ddev mcp-login codex{RESET} or {BOLD}ddev mcp-login opencode{RESET}.
{BOLD}Evals{RESET} are installed: grade a migration attempt with {BOLD}ddev eval grade{RESET} (see .drupalaibp/evals/README.md).
